name: @kucedr-plugins/bootstrap-dither
description: Bootstrap plugin script that renders any dithercn component as self-contained HTML.

scripts.build: tailwindcss -i src/styles.css -o dist/styles.css --minify && esbuild src/browser.jsx --bundle --minify --jsx=automatic --format=iife --outfile=dist/browser.js && esbuild src/index.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs
